siteTagline: Direct connection between sellers and buyers
headerAyahText: Is it you who make it grow, or are We the grower?
siteIntro: Zareoon is an online marketplace for various products, connecting producers, suppliers, and buyers directly.
marketplaceDirectBody: Zareoon helps businesses connect buyers, sellers, and trade-service providers across Iran and international markets. Deals are made directly by the parties; in ordinary transactions Zareoon is neither a contracting party nor a broker. Alongside cash trade, goods-for-goods and goods-for-services exchange are also available. Before any agreement or payment, carefully review the terms.
marketplaceDirectBuyersBody: Reach wholesale sellers in Iran and abroad, negotiate without middlemen, and use goods-for-goods or goods-for-services exchange when it fits.
marketplaceDirectSellersBody: Showcase products to domestic and international buyers, sell directly, and enable goods-for-goods or goods-for-services exchange alongside cash sales.
marketplaceDirectServicesBody: Present your trade services to buyers and sellers in Iran and global markets; partner directly, and when agreed, exchange goods for services too.
whatIsZareoonIntro: Zareoon connects buyers, sellers, and trade-service providers directly, and showcases products and services in one online marketplace.
whatIsZareoonBuyersBody: On Zareoon, buyers can easily reach wholesale sellers across Iran without middlemen and communicate with them directly.
whatIsZareoonSellersBody: Sellers list products on Zareoon to find wholesale buyers and sell without intermediaries. Built-in promotional tools help them sell faster.
whatIsZareoonServicesBody: Trade-service providers (packaging, customs, logistics, finance, and more) present their expertise on Zareoon so buyers and sellers can partner with them directly.

escrowDescription: Optional tools help users coordinate; using them does not mean Zareoon takes on deal liability.
escrowSectionIntro1: Escrow is an optional tool to hold funds until deal milestones are confirmed.
escrowItem1: Calculate and manage guarantee amounts based on deal terms
escrowItem2: Hold funds until buyer and seller confirm
escrowItem3: Release in full or in stages after delivery or service completion

escrowExampleText: For a $50,000 deal, the buyer places $15,000 in escrow. After loading and document confirmation, 50% is released to the seller; the rest after delivery. If goods do not match the contract, the buyer opens a dispute.
escrowFooter: Even with optional tools, Zareoon is not a party to the deal and bears no liability for user agreements or disputes.
escrowGuideBody: Escrow is an optional tool that holds agreed funds until deal milestones are met. After each stage is confirmed by the parties, funds are released per the agreement. Zareoon is not a party to the deal; quality, final payment, and dispute resolution remain with buyer and seller.
lcSectionIntro: For domestic and international deals, LC-related features only help users coordinate.
zareoonServicesLiabilityNote: Full responsibility for the deal, payment, and obligations always stays with buyer and seller; Zareoon has no liability.

pwaInstalledLabel: Zareoon is installed on this device
pwaIosHint: On iPhone: Share → Add to Home Screen
pwaGuideIos:
1. In Safari, tap the Share button.
2. Choose “Add to Home Screen”.
3. Tap Add to install Zareoon like an app.
pwaGuideAndroid:
1. Open the browser menu (⋮).
2. Tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
3. Confirm the install.
If you don’t see it, open the site in Chrome and wait a moment.
pwaGuideDesktop:
1. In Chrome or Edge, click the install icon in the address bar.
2. Or choose Install from the browser menu.
3. Confirm — supported on Windows, Mac, and Linux.
pwaGuideGeneric:
Your browser did not show a one-click install prompt.
Use the browser menu → Install or Add to Home Screen.
Prefer an up-to-date Chrome or Edge if the option is missing.
pwaGuideDenied:
Install was cancelled or did not finish.
Tap “Install Zareoon on your device” again, or use the browser menu → Install / Add to Home Screen.
